market_summary: All five monitored instruments are consolidating in low-volatility regimes during the London session ahead of the New York open. Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and BTCUSD are churning inside their respective session Value Areas around POC magnets, below VWAP and EMA50 baselines with subdued sub-1.0 RVOL. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) printed minor sweeps of their session lows near lower ATR bands, but lack yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout volume and face immediate overhead resistance from descending VWAP and EMA20 levels. With all markets range-bound and showing no institutional momentum catalyst, strict risk discipline requires holding across the entire portfolio.
